punchline: Sleep may be the most powerful legal performance enhancer there is.
thirty_sec: In Why We Sleep, Matthew Walker argues that sleep is a powerful performance enhancer. Short sleep reduces time to exhaustion. During sleep, the brain replays and strengthens newly learned movements, so skills often improve overnight. A study of young athletes found those who slept less had a much higher injury risk. Many pro teams now treat sleep as part of training.
question: What are you practicing right now that needs a full night's sleep to stick?
